title: DevOps Badge
description: Hands-on DevOps assessment. Sixteen scenarios across containers, Kubernetes, Helm, CI and artifact management, then all six bootcamp capstones (Jenkins to Kubernetes, microservices with Helm, Ansible to Kubernetes, CI/CD with Terraform, Ansible in Jenkins, Python monitoring) — each a broken or empty environment you must fix. Auto-graded; a failed check still lets you move on.
